title: 7-Day High Intensity Calorie Burning Workout Program
summary: Join FightCamp Trainer Shanie Smash for 7 days of high intensity calorie burning exercises that will get your heart pumping and will have you feeling the BURN.
body_markdown:
This program consists of high-intensity full-body workouts designed to elevate your heart rate up and burn lots of calories.


* Don't forget, each FightCamp workout includes a quick warmup and a stretch but you can always add on an extended cool down for good measure.


## MONDAY


-


8-ROUND **Burnout Boxing**


-


Sprawl and Brawl Sprint


## TUESDAY

## How To Get Started


1.


Open the FightCamp app and click "See All" in the top right corner of the homepage.


2.


Use the "Filters" toggle at the bottom of the page to search for the workouts by the number of rounds.


3.


Scroll to find a workout.


4.


Get


**#ShanieSmashed** !
